findings.description: The reports bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so stored objects (including the seeded vendor roster) are not guaranteed to be encrypted with a managed/customer KMS key. Sensitive report data would be stored without explicit encryption at rest.

findings.issue_category: no explicit ACL or public access block
findings.description: Unlike the other buckets, this bucket sets no acl = "private" and there is no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource anywhere in the file, leaving the bucket dependent on account-level defaults and vulnerable to accidental public ACL/policy grants.
No logging block is configured, so object access to this bucket is not recorded to the audit_trail bucket, hindering detection and forensic investigation of unauthorised access.

Versioning is not enabled and force_destroy = true is set, so objects can be overwritten or destroyed (accidentally or by an attacker) with no recoverable prior version and no protection against bucket deletion while populated.
The ledger export bucket defines no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial export data is stored without an explicitly enforced KMS/SSE default.
No logging block is configured for this bucket holding ledger exports, so reads and writes are not audited to the audit_trail bucket.
Versioning is absent while force_destroy = true is set, meaning ledger export objects can be silently overwritten or deleted with no recovery path, undermining data integrity of financial records.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is declared, so model artifacts are stored without an enforced default encryption policy, unlike the audit_trail bucket which uses a KMS CMK.

The runbooks bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration; operational runbooks often contain hostnames, procedures and occasionally credentials and should be encrypted at rest with a managed key.
No logging block is configured, so access to operational runbook content is not recorded in the central audit_trail bucket.

findings.issue_category: missing access logging on log bucket
findings.description: The audit trail bucket itself has no access logging configured, so tampering with or exfiltration of centralized log data cannot be detected. Combined with force_destroy = true, the audit evidence store can also be deleted along with all its contents.
